create_SACAgent: create a SACAgent with a policy model and action dimension for reinforcement learning
run_SACAgent_call: run one step of the SACAgent to sample stochastic or greedy actions from observations
build_SACPolicy: build a SACPolicy neural network that outputs mean and std for a diagonal Gaussian actor
build_SACQ: build a SACQ critic network that estimates Q-values from state-action pairs
create_SquashedNormal: create a SquashedNormal distribution that applies tanh transform to a base Normal distribution
